sentences.text: 2. Briefly stated the case of the prosecution is that on 16.03.2024 an information was received at PS Shaheen Bagh regarding an alleged wrongful act involving a girl under the age of 18 years.
The prosecutrix on being enquired stated that she had come to Delhi 20 years ago along with some unknown girls from Odisha.
In Delhi she was living in Gopinath area at an agency and from there the petitioner brought her to Rajokri area of New Delhi and she started living there on rent.
The prosecutrix alleged that the petitioner had assaulted her sexually and at that time she was 7 years old.
It was further alleged that the petitioner kept her in Rajokari for one year and after that he kept her in a rented room in Punjabi Bagh for 15 years and sexually assaulted her there also.
The prosecutrix alleged that even though the petitioner got married in 2019, however, he continued to sexually assault her forcibly.
3. The perusal of the status report indicates that at the time of medical examination the complainant was around 35 years of age.
The perusal of the statement u/s 164 Cr.PC also indicates that the last alleged sexual assault was around five years back in 2019.

The statement u/s 164 Cr.PC also indicates that there was a quarrel between the prosecutrix and the wife of the petitioner after which allegedly, the wife of the petitioner gave beating to the prosecutrix and threw her goods out.
The prosecutrix was allegedly not given her salary.
